name: Hisense SmartTV 4K FFM (Android 11)
summary: Hisense SmartTV 4K FFM (Android 11) ships with demo mode and setup leftovers. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and undo.
intro: This Hisense SmartTV 4K FFM runs Android 11. It ships with retail demo mode, a first-time experience, a Google partner stub that installs apps silently and an on-screen disclaimer app. The Google TV setup wizard is also on the list. There are 6 apps. It is a short, careful list.

Applied in two batches with a restart after, with no crashes and a normal boot. Three Hisense smart services must stay on, because a longer list that turned them off sent a sister model to Android Recovery. TidyTV keeps them on and turns the rest off with a backup first. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: The Hisense smart sense and AIoT services, which the TV needs to boot
The Live TV and HDMI app and the TV input service
The Hisense smart service and customer launcher
notes: Three Hisense services must never be turned off. Turning them off sent a sister model to Android Recovery.
Several apps were already off from the factory, such as YouTube Music and Play Games.

faq.q: Is it safe on my Hisense SmartTV 4K FFM?
faq.a: The list is short and careful. It leaves out the three services that sent a sister model to Android Recovery.
Yes. The services behind the HDMI, AV and tuner inputs are kept.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns the apps back on and puts the Google TV home screen back in one tap.
